tasks.label: Iniciar Emulador Pixel 10a
tasks.command: $serial = (adb devices | Select-String 'emulator-\d+\s+device' | ForEach-Object { ($_ -split '\s+')[0] } | Select-Object -First 1); if (-not $serial) { flutter emulators --launch Pixel_10a; do { Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; $serial = (adb devices | Select-String 'emulator-\d+\s+device' | ForEach-Object { ($_ -split '\s+')[0] } | Select-Object -First 1) } until ($serial -and ((adb -s $serial shell getprop sys.boot_completed 2>$null) -eq '1')) }
